changelog: Valenixia POS v2.6.2 - Purged word AI across entire app, resolved 53 duplicate element IDs, and implemented dynamic filter panel.
changes: Single integer pricing catalog (PKR) with Math.round(monthly * 12 * 85 / 100) annual discount calculations
Immutable server subscription quote engine (/api/subscription/quote) with 24-hour quote expiration
Append-only billing_events ledger protected by SQLite database engine triggers prohibiting UPDATE and DELETE
Starter tier branch expansion rejection gate returning structured BRANCH_EXPANSION_REQUIRES_UPGRADE code
Interactive Merchant Monetization UI with independent Terminal and Branch capacity sliders and upgrade recommendation engine
Multi-dimensional telemetry filter bar across Branch, Terminal, Cashier, Category, and Payment Method
Revenue Control Tower separating Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) from One-Time Revenue
